content: मेधाविन् {%a.%} [मेधा-विनि] .²1 Very intelligent, having a good memory. .²2 Intelligent, wise, endowed with intellect; मेधाविनो नीतिगुणप्रयुक्तां पुरः स्फुरन्तीमिव दर्शयन्ति <ls>Pt. 1. 61</ls>; मेधावी छिन्नसंशयः <ls>Bg. 18. 10</ls>. --{%m.%} .²1 A learned man, sage, scholar. .²2 A parrot. .²3 An intoxicating drink. .{@-नी@} An epithet of the wife of Brahmā.
